posts.text: @sanketkulkarni1987 If you look at the total capex cost of Rs.184 crore, plant & machinery cost is only Rs.17 crores. Most of the cost is land, building, electrical installations, interiors, furniture etc. which will house R&D and application & training centers. That’s the nature of this business. image 669×700 105 KB (Compiled from DRHP) See the photo from Google Maps - there are two towers next to each other - more like an office than a factory. Sacheerome YEIDA 1510×857 251 KB I think management must have concluded that this cannot be built in phases, or is more cost effective to build ever…
